head: 81609b6a3c9b474cce6db97b07a57988abbc34d3
title: fix(coach-team): team profile shares the working invite link; Team tab only for real teams (AUDIT-16-125)
body:
**Tier:** T2 (coach-facing copy, navigation and tab visibility; no money, auth, tenancy, PII or data writes changed)
**Why:** Settings -> Team / Gym profile advertises a team code no sign-up path accepts, and every coach gets a Team tab that can only show the plan gate (AUDIT-16-125, agent 125).
**T4 trigger scan:** none. No backend, auth, RLS/tenancy, payment, credential or destructive-data change. The Team tab gate only narrows who sees the tab (fails closed, same `/coach/team/members` call as today).
**T3 trigger scan:** none. No schema, migration, dependency, lockfile or flag change.
**Bounded T1:** 3 source files (`useCoachRoleType.ts`, `CoachNavigator.tsx`, `CoachTeamProfileScreen.tsx`) + 2 existing test files. 198 changed lines.
**Canonical builder:** Claude Opus 5.5 (AUDIT-16-125).
**Acceptance evidence:** PR CI (lint, typecheck, full jest). Updated assertions in `src/__tests__/coachSaasBlockers.test.ts` fail on main (main shows and shares `profile.team_code`, shows `client_capacity`, navigates to `TeamManagement`); new `useCoachTeamStatus` tests in `src/__tests__/coachTeamP0Blockers.test.tsx` fail on main (export does not exist).

Works against the current production backend: uses only existing routes (`GET /coach/team`, `GET /coach/team/members`, `GET /coaches/me/invite-link` through the existing `InviteShareCard`).

## Fixes

- **B-16-1 (false claim, sign-up dead end).** A coach sets up a team profile and sends the "TEAM CODE" (GP-TEAM-...) to a new client; the client enters it at sign-up and is told the code is not valid, so they cannot join the coach. No sign-up or join path reads `TeamProfile.team_code` (backend: only `src/team` touches it; `invite-codes` validate / previewCode / resolveAttachTarget read `InviteCode.code` and `CoachProfile.invite_code`). The card now shows the coach's permanent invite link (`InviteShareCard`: Share, Copy, QR, loading and error states) and the false copy is gone.
- **U-16-1 (dead button).** "Manage sub-coaches" called `navigate('TeamManagement')` from the Settings stack; that route lives only inside the Team tab stack and React Navigation 7 does not navigate into a sibling tab's child by name, so the tap did nothing. Row removed.
- **U-16-2 (wrong number).** "Seats" and "Open" showed an invented capacity (30 for every coach, from an unknown tier) although coaches have no seat limit; a coach with 30+ clients saw "Open 0". Removed; the Clients count stays.
- **U-16-3 (dead tab, store-review risk).** `/coach/team/members` lists every coach as the head coach of their own roster, so every coach got a Team tab, and `TeamManagementScreen` always shows the plan gate (it reads `plan_tier` from `/auth/me`, which never returns it, and no coach has a Scale tier). The tab now mounts only for a head coach whose roster has at least one sub-coach. `useCoachRoleType` keeps its contract (now a thin wrapper over `useCoachTeamStatus`).

## Overlap
- m#412 changes the `UpgradeGate` import/copy in `TeamManagementScreen.tsx`; this PR does not touch that file.

## Not in this PR (reported to operator)
- The sub-coach invite has no in-app accept path (invite URL `.../sub-coach/<token>` has no route; nothing calls `POST /sub-coaches/invites/accept`). Sub-coach teams stay unavailable on day 1; this PR makes the app say so by not showing them.
